- Target close options: Option A — accelerated (6–8 weeks, target Jul 31) | Option B — standard (10–12 weeks, target Aug 15)

  1) MAP kickoff & stakeholder alignment — week 0 (confirm today) — Owners: NovaCare (S. Cole), Redwood (Marissa)
  2) Security questionnaire & evidence submission — week 1–2 — Owners: NovaCare SecOps, Redwood Security (Rishi)
  3) Pilot setup & validation (3-day pilot) — week 3–5 (depends on infra access) — Owners: NovaCare Eng, Redwood Solutions
  4) Commercial & legal: final terms, PO/contract execution — week 6–10 — Owners: NovaCare Procurement, Redwood Legal
  5) Production enablement & handoff — final week — Owners: NovaCare Ops, Redwood CS

Dependencies: access to test environment or sample data, completed security questionnaire, and internal procurement timeline (PO lead time).

Ask: Please confirm (a) which timeline option you prefer, (b) primary stakeholders we should loop into the kickoff (name + role), and (c) whether the attached MAP draft looks correct or needs changes. Once you confirm, I'll schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff with the right folks.
